          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: |
          yarn generate-inline-fizz-runtime
          git diff --quiet || (echo "There was a change to the Fizz runtime. Run `yarn generate-inline-fizz-runtime` and check in the result." && false)

  # ----- FEATURE FLAGS -----
  flags:
    name: Check flags
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn flags

  # ----- TESTS -----
  test:
    name: yarn test ${{ matrix.params }} (Shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        params:
          - "-r=stable --env=development"
          - "-r=stable --env=production"
          - "-r=experimental --env=development"
          - "-r=experimental --env=production"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=production --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=production --variant=true"
          - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=xplat --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=xplat --env=production --variant=true"
          # TODO: Test more persistent configurations?
          - "-r=stable --env=development --persistent"
          - "-r=experimental --env=development --persistent"

          - 2/5
          - 3/5
          - 4/5

    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn test ${{ matrix.params }} --ci --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}

    strategy:

        release_channel: [stable, experimental]
    steps:

        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4

          # - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=true"

        uses: actions/cache@v4

      - name: Display structure of build for PR
        run: ls -R build
      - name: Restore archived base-build from origin/main
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: base-build
          path: base-build
      - name: Display structure of base-build from origin/main
        run: ls -R base-build

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

        with:
          script: |
            const inlinedHostConfigs = require('./scripts/shared/inlinedHostConfigs.js');
            return inlinedHostConfigs.map(config => config.shortName);

    name: Flow check ${{ matrix.flow_inline_config_shortname }}

        flow_inline_config_shortname: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover_flow_inline_configs.outputs.matrix) }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock

        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: node ./scripts/tasks/flow-ci ${{ matrix.flow_inline_config_shortname }}

      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: |

    name: Check flags
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn flags

  # ----- TESTS -----
  test:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

        uses: actions/cache@v4

name: (Runtime) Build and Test

jobs:

    name: Flow check ${{ matrix.flow_inline_config_shortname }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock

      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: node ./scripts/tasks/flow-ci ${{ matrix.flow_inline_config_shortname }}

  check_generated_fizz_runtime:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: |
          yarn generate-inline-fizz-runtime
          git diff --quiet || (echo "There was a change to the Fizz runtime. Run `yarn generate-inline-fizz-runtime` and check in the result." && false)

  # ----- FEATURE FLAGS -----
  flags:
    name: Check flags
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn flags

  # ----- TESTS -----
  test:
    name: yarn test ${{ matrix.params }} (Shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        params:
          - "-r=stable --env=development"
          - "-r=stable --env=production"
          - "-r=experimental --env=development"
          - "-r=experimental --env=production"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-classic --env=production --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=www-modern --env=production --variant=true"
          - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=false"
          - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=true"
          - "-r=xplat --env=production --variant=false"
          - "-r=xplat --env=production --variant=true"
          # TODO: Test more persistent configurations?

          - "-r=experimental --env=development --persistent"

          - 3/5
          - 4/5

    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
      - name: Restore cached node_modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: node_modules
        with:
          path: "**/node_modules"
          key: ${{ runner.arch }}-${{ runner.os }}-modules-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock') }}

      - run: yarn test ${{ matrix.params }} --ci --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}

    strategy:

    steps:

        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4

          # - "-r=xplat --env=development --variant=true"

      - name: Display structure of build for PR
        run: ls -R build
      - name: Restore archived base-build from origin/main
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: base-build
          path: base-build
      - name: Display structure of base-build from origin/main
